items.title: Tech stocks today: Microsoft, Meta, Qualcomm report earnings as chip stocks struggle
items.summary: Tech stocks were mixed on Tuesday, as chip stocks continued to selloff ahead of earnings.

items.title: S&P 8,500 melt-up? Why money is leaving big tech
items.summary: Trader Talk host Kenny Polcari, Robinhood CIO Stephanie Guild, and Payne Capital Management President Ryan Payne break down the market's massive rotation out of big tech, the reality of AI infrastructure spending, and the bold case for an S&P 8,500 melt-up by year-end.

items.title: Markets brace for Fed decision and Big Tech earnings
items.summary: Josh Lipton stock the market movers for Wednesday, July 29th, including the Federal Reserve's interest rate decision. After the closing bell, Microsoft (MSFT) and Meta (META) report second quarter earnings, with investors watching closely for signs that their massive AI investments are beginning to pay off.

items.title: Microsoft tops estimates as Azure passes $100 billion annually
items.summary: Microsoft on Wednesday reported quarterly revenue and earnings that beat Wall Street expectations, while announcing that annual Azure revenue has surpassed $100 billion.

items.title: Microsoft Azure growth reaches 43% as cloud backlog climbs to $678 billion
items.summary: Azure surpassed $100 billion in annual revenue as Microsoft’s cloud backlog jumped 84%, strengthening the revenue case for its costly AI infrastructure buildout.

items.title: Microsoft’s (NASDAQ:MSFT) Q2 CY2026: Beats On Revenue
items.summary: Technology giant Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 17.7% year on year to $90.01 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.81 per share was 14.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Microsoft Smashes June-Quarter Targets On AI, Cloud Strength
items.summary: Microsoft crushed Wall Street's targets for its fiscal fourth quarter thanks to cloud computing and AI strength. Microsoft stock rose late.
